title: Per-person membership index so listing does not scan every account (256-account cap)
description: From the Papyrus side (gap 7 in the Papyrus gap audit). The account list and the directory scan every account file and return 503 above 256 accounts in total, not per person, and accounts are capped at 100 memberships. Not blocking p.apyr.us today. A hosted newsroom serving many sites will hit it. Needed: a per-Person membership index. Prospectus owns the design. Raised by the Papyrus Prospectus-integration thread; decision on priority is Ryan's.
